==========================================
__has_include with angle brackets
==========================================

#if __has_include(<endian.h>)
int a;
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (system_lib_string)))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier))))

            (identifier)))
        (number_literal)))

      (primitive_type)
      (identifier))))

            (primitive_type)
            (identifier))

            (identifier)))

          (primitive_type)
          (identifier))))
    (compound_statement))

================================================================================

  int n;

}

          (condition_clause
            (identifier))
          (compound_statement
            (expression_statement
              (assignment_expression
                (identifier)
                (number_literal))))))
      (compound_statement
        (expression_statement
          (assignment_expression
            (identifier)
            (number_literal)))))))

================================================================================
preproc group as an unbraced statement body (dangling if/while/for/do)
================================================================================

void f() {
    if (!x)
#ifdef MAC
        a();
#else
        b();
#endif
    while (x)
#ifdef MAC
        y();
#endif
    for (;;)
#ifdef MAC
        z();
#endif
    do
#ifdef MAC
        w();
#endif
    while (x);
    if (a) s1();
    else
#ifdef MAC
        s2();
#endif
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list))
    (compound_statement
      (if_statement
        (condition_clause
          (unary_expression
            (identifier)))
        (preproc_ifdef
          (identifier)
          (expression_statement
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (argument_list)))
          (preproc_else
            (expression_statement
              (call_expression
                (identifier)
                (argument_list))))))
      (while_statement
        (condition_clause
          (identifier))
        (preproc_ifdef
          (identifier)
          (expression_statement
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (argument_list)))))
      (for_statement
        (preproc_ifdef
          (identifier)
          (expression_statement
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (argument_list)))))
      (do_statement
        (preproc_ifdef
          (identifier)
          (expression_statement
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (argument_list))))
        (parenthesized_expression
          (identifier)))
      (if_statement
        (condition_clause
          (identifier))
        (expression_statement
          (call_expression
            (identifier)
            (argument_list)))
        (else_clause
          (preproc_ifdef
            (identifier)
            (expression_statement
              (call_expression
                (identifier)
                (argument_list)))))))))

================================================================================

# * banner idiom                                            */
# */

int c(void);
#endif
#pragma whatever
#warning hi
int d(void) {
#
    return 0;
}

      (identifier)

      (expression_statement

            scope: (namespace_identifier)

          arguments: (argument_list))))))
